hero.title: MedChem Structure Genius
hero.summary:
MedChem Structure Genius is an e-learning application designed for students at the Faculty of Pharmacy at the University of Lille to help them study molecules and their relationships. 
In collaboration with a team of five students from ISEN, I am leading this project by defining the client's needs, facilitating weekly meetings, and ensuring follow-up while contributing directly to development. 
We are improving the reliability and usability of the application: fixing display bugs on Android and the web, resolving quiz generation errors, improving the review and score tracking interfaces, optimizing the code, correcting texts, and creating an explanatory diagram of the quiz generation mechanism and typical queries on Supabase to facilitate data exploration. 
The project is still in progress, so feel free to ask me any questions you may have!
